vintages.Decree 67/2023 as made: in force from 6 September 2023 (Article 77(1)); governs a contract concluded from that day, and an earlier one the parties amended to apply it
vintages.Decree 67/2023 as amended by Decree 220/: in force from 1 July 2026 (Decree 220 Article 10(1)); governs a contract concluded from that day, and an earlier one the parties amended to apply it (Article 10(2))
vintages.difference for the motor chapter: the word for the third party only ('người thứ ba' becomes 'bên thứ ba', Decree 220 Article 9(1)); no answer differs
vintages.other amending decrees read: Decree 105/2025/ND-CP Article 44(1) (in force 1 July 2025) and Decree 347/2026/ND-CP Article 28 (in force 15 September 2026) amend only fire-insurance provisions of Decree 67/2023 (Articles 4(5)(b), 23-31, Annex II); neither reaches Articles 1-13's motor provisions, Annex I or Annex VI (NOTES.md section 1.2a). Read 2026-10-07 from gazette and government PDFs, not deposited.
vintages.Decree 03/2021 with Circular 04/2021: added 2026-10-13 (NOTES.md section 1.5): not a vintage of Decree 67 but the earlier regime Article 76(1) continues; governs a contract concluded from 1 March 2021 (Decree 03 Article 47(1)) to 5 September 2023 that the parties did not amend to apply Decree 67 or Decree 220. Encoded where it differs from Decree 67 (scope, alcohol, the 50 cc premium band, premium increase only, term, change of owner, termination grounds, refund, the advance, one row of the table of payments); answered through Decree 67's rules where the two are the same. A contract concluded before 1 March 2021 is declined (Decree 03 Article 46: Decree 103/2008 and its amendments, not in the sources).

scope: Encoded: Chapter II Section 1 in full (Articles 5-13); Chapter I as the motor chapter uses it (Article 2(1), 3(1)-(3), 3(5)(a), 4(1), (3), (4), (5)(a), (7) bound, (8)); Annex I in full (sections A, A.VII and B); Annex VI in full (Parts A and B, 1,135 rows; the 10 x 10 acuity table; 2 of 17 notes; special cases 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, with 2 as an input convention); Decree 67 Articles 76(1), 77(1) and Decree 220 Articles 9(1), 10(1)-(2) for the vintage. Inert: Article 1, 2(4)-(5), 3 chapeau, 4(6)(a), 4(10), 12 chapeau, the chapter headings, 15 notes of Annex VI. Out of scope: Chapter II Section 2 (the Motor Vehicle Insurance Fund), Chapters III-V, Chapter VI beyond the vintage, Annexes II-V and VII-X, Decree 220 Articles 1-8, 9(2)-(4), 10(3), Article 3(4), (5)(b), (6)-(10), 4(5)(b)-(c), 4(6)(b), 4(9). Reached and refused by name: the Minister of Finance's premium payment deadline (4(7)); a refund on a change of owner (9(3) with 11); two contracts concluded on the same first day (12(9)); and, as named refusals inside encoded rules, a contract concluded before Decree 67, a band of Annex VI with no assessed rate, a row whose 'cộng lùi' addition applies, an unlisted injury with no rate. See NOTES.md sections 1-2. Added 2026-10-13: Decree 03/2021 Articles 5, 7(3)-(4), 9-11, 13, 14(2)-(3), 46, 47(1) and its Annex I item B.IV 2.1.2, and Circular 04/2021 Articles 3-4 and Annex I, where they differ from Decree 67 (NOTES.md section 1.5); not encoded for Decree 03: special-purpose machines, the certificate's particulars (Article 6), the claim and payment deadlines (Article 16), the duties of Articles 17-20 beyond those Decree 67 shares, the Motor Vehicle Insurance Fund.

forks.F1: The vintage is decided by the date the contract was concluded and any agreed amendment, not by the accident or claim date.
forks.F2: 'bên thứ ba' (Decree 220) names the same persons as 'người thứ ba'.
forks.F3: Vehicle kinds, driver age and licence rules are inputs (Road Traffic Law; whether the 2008 Law is in force is unverified); Annex I sections I-III map to Article 6(2)(a), IV-VII to (b).
forks.F4: Article 3(2): 'under control' governs moving, stopping and parking.
forks.F5: Article 7(2)(c): the licence qualifier governs every licence limb (the last-antecedent reading is kept for finding R3).
forks.F6: Article 7(2)(a): the injured person's intent excludes only that person's damage.
forks.F7: Article 7(2)(đ): the drug limb is property-only, like the alcohol limb.
forks.F8: Article 9(1): 1 and 3 years inclusive; a year is the same day and month a year on.
forks.F9: Annex I B: the days of a term are Day(end) - Day(begin).
forks.F10: No rounding of premiums or refunds.
forks.F11: Article 8(2) adjusts the Annex I premium of the contract's own term.
forks.F12: Article 11 refund pro rata by days, the day of revocation counted as used.
forks.F13: Special case 3 is Annex VI B.VIII 1.4 (87%).
forks.F14: Working days: Monday to Friday less the caller's days off.
forks.F15: Article 12(3)(b) 'tử vong và ... 81%' is two cases.
forks.F16: A persistent vegetative state is a partial injury for Article 12(3)(a) (Annex VI B.I 4.1).
forks.F17: Degree of fault: the owner's share multiplies the amount.
forks.F18: Under the third-party-fault rule a court's figure is held to the 50% ceiling.
forks.F19: Article 12(9): two contracts concluded the same first day are declined.
forks.F20: Article 13(3): injury needs (3)(a) or (3)(b); death needs (3)(c).
forks.F21: Article 13(2)(b) licence only where one is required; (6) always.
forks.F22: The anchor day of a working-day period is not counted.
forks.F23: Article 12(3)'s 3 working days run from the first (hotline) notice.
forks.F26: Article 12(2)'s 24 hours run from receipt of the notice.
forks.F27: The insurer pays the Article 12(6) amount; 12(5) says to whom.
forks.F28: Annex VI amount: the assessed point within the band (an input; declined without it).
forks.F29: Article 6(2) property limit aggregates every person's property in the accident.
forks.F30: A legal person can be a third party.
forks.F31: Article 9(1)(b): remaining service life under 1 year.
forks.F32: Decree 220 Article 10(2): a pre-July-2026 compulsory contract continues under the decree as made.
forks.F34: All third-party damage is taken as non-contractual (Article 7(1)(a)).
forks.F35: The 50% third-party-fault rule does not reach passengers.
forks.F36: Article 12(1)(b)'s exception is a fact about the act.
forks.LAW: L1-L9 (NOTES.md section 3): payment within 15 days (Law Art 31(1)); 1-year claim deadline (Art 30(1)); late-notice reduction proportional to the insurer's damage (Art 46(1)) against Article 12(7)'s 5%, not resolved; force majeure (Art 19(3)); no refusal to sell (Art 8(4)); contra proferentem (Art 24); no direct claim unless provided (Art 58(2)); costs and interest (Art 59(3)-(4)); termination (Arts 26-27). None encoded.
forks.F37: Decree 03 Article 5: the scope does not require the vehicle to have been in traffic or operating (Article 2(1) says who the decree applies to, not which damage is covered).
forks.F38: Decree 03 Article 9(1)(b): a term over 1 year for a vehicle other than a motorcycle or moped turns on its inspection interval, not among the facts; declined by name.
forks.F39: Decree 03 Article 11(1)(b): the reasonable costs deducted from the refund are not quantified; the refund is given before them, and the contract-level refund is declined.
forks.F40: Decree 03 Article 13(3): one fact, 'an invalid driving licence', for Decree 03's and Decree 67's different definitions.
forks.F41: Decree 03 Article 14(2): the advance for a partial injury turns on emergency treatment, a fact the caller gives.
